snippet.description:

Someone tested 9 of the most popular Claude skill packs against a blank dummy file. 7 of them lost.

Claude Code has changed more in the last 10 months than most people realise, and a lot of the habits we all picked up early on are now quietly costing you tokens, time and quality. Here are 15 changes most people have missed, from a single chat all the way to Claude running jobs while you're away. Most apply to Codex, Cursor and the desktop apps too.
